response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional software craftsmanship, strong system design skills, and excellent communication abilities, he lacks the critical technical foundations required for this role. He has no demonstrated expertise in Kotlin, minimal Java experience limited to peripheral work, no Spring ecosystem background, and critically, no IDE development or JVM language tooling experience. His career has been built on full-stack web development and backend services across diverse technologies, not the specialized Java/Spring/IDE focus this position requires.
strengths: Exemplary software craftsmanship with consistent emphasis on TDD, clean architecture, and CI/CD practices across multiple roles
Proven ability to design and maintain complex systems at scale, including microservices handling millions of requests per second
Strong communication and collaboration skills demonstrated through technical workshops, conference speaking, and sustained open-source community contributions
concerns: No Kotlin expertise and only minimal Java experience (limited to robotic systems and device orchestration work at Altom Consulting)
Completely lacks Spring ecosystem and enterprise framework experience, which is fundamental to this role's core responsibilities
No IDE development or language tooling background; only brief exposure to C IDE internals at National Instruments, insufficient for a specialized IDE/JVM tooling position

key_factors.factor: Demonstrated system design and architectural thinking
Recent developer tooling experience at re:cinq
